objective.title: Transfer and qualify exact quantity and temperature comparison

declared.summary: Establish two independent pre-transfer RED contracts; copy pinned ApproximateEquivalence from AURA, add exact symmetric quantity and tagged temperature comparison policy, test inclusive and negative tolerance boundaries, and qualify the whole C04 slice in one run.
declared.value: Delivers exact, dimension-aware comparison behavior without floating-point fallback; handles zero, large BigInteger, symmetric relative bounds and affine temperature tolerances while preserving historical source provenance.
debtChanges: Transferred AURA ApproximateEquivalence is hash-pinned, but its inherited overloads are not all behavior-qualified; the independent ExactComparisonPolicy API receives this run's mathematical oracles.
TemperatureMeasurement comparison assumes both operands were normalized to a common base scale by UnitDefinition's typed conversions; raw measurements from different units must never be compared.
Legacy scalar unit conversions remain callable and cannot encode affine point/interval semantics; Math's tagged temperature APIs must be used for that boundary.
declared.nextAction: Refine M1-W02-C01 catalog source and dependencies, then qualify a useful catalog and unit-resolution vertical in a bounded substantive run.

achievements.achievement: Before installing comparison source and policy, an independent test records their absence and the authorized AURA source SHA, establishing the exact-comparison contract RED.
ApproximateEquivalence is transferred from owner-authorized AURA with exact pinned SHA and the new comparison entry points implement exact inclusive symmetric quantity tolerances.
Rational equality, 1 m versus 101 cm inclusive absolute tolerance, dimension compatibility, relative max-magnitude and exact large-integer comparisons pass independent focused tests and regressions.
The exact quantity-comparison transfer is completed from pre-transfer RED through source-pinned GREEN, independent exact oracles and regression evidence.
An independent pre-implementation RED test records that tagged temperature comparison is absent from Math.
Typed temperature comparisons admit interval-only absolute tolerances and reject negative, invalid-kind or mixed absolute/interval inputs without changing exact values.
Temperature boundary oracles, all C04 tests, the full dw.quantities test project and foundation chain pass, with normalization requirements and limits documented.
The tagged temperature tolerance boundary contract is completed from RED through GREEN and integrated qualification.
The exact comparisons and tolerances chunk is complete with pinned import, precise quantity/temperature policies, independent boundary tests and durable evidence.
